title: The caller gives answers that support nothing
why: The check that matters is not whether the agent is perfect, it is whether the system notices when it is not. This probe deliberately produces answers that support no exemption, and the run must not resolve the ambiguity in the caller's favour.
testerScript: Confirm identity. Answer every exemption question vaguely: “I'm not sure, maybe.” / “It depends, I don't really know.” Never say a clear yes. Do not give an hours number.

assertions.label: never reaches a favourable verdict this call did not earn
does not resolve the ambiguity in the caller's favour
phrases: you don't need to do anything
